_comment: FROZEN golden burn attestation, the burn counterpart of mint-attestation.json: same domain and same auditor/profileDigest/metadataDigest/amount/nonce/validUntil/vault field values, with recordKey replaced by operationId (BurnAttestation has no recordKey). Its domainSeparator/hashStruct/digest are exercised by the Go signer (signer/internal/attestation/attestation_test.go, TestSolanaBurnVector) and by server/internal/eip712/attestation_test.go; its signature/recoveryId are recovered and low-S-checked by the Go signer only -- the Rust verifier (solana/crates/attestation) and the TypeScript parity test (solana/tests/attestation-parity.ts) pin the mint vector, so treat this file's signature as Go-verified rather than a proven cross-language parity anchor. digest is the raw 32-byte keccak digest that secp256k1_recover(digest, signature, recoveryId) must recover `auditor` from (no message-prefixing of any kind is applied). signature is the 64-byte compact r||s form the on-chain syscall consumes -- the recovery byte is carried separately as recoveryId (0 or 1), not appended -- and is canonical low-S, which the on-chain verifier requires. Produced by a fixed, publicly-known test key; never use it for anything real.
